growth_signal.value: The company's own website says it already has more than 3,000 installer customers using its platform.

entry.idea: Small companies that install solar panels and heat pumps have to juggle sales, planning, paperwork and installation with no proper software, so Reonic gives them one AI-powered platform to plan, sell, and manage the whole job.
entry.lesson: Find a trade that is growing fast but still runs on paper and spreadsheets, and sell them one piece of software that replaces all their separate tools.
entry.name: Reonic

growth.reason: No revenue or growth-rate numbers were given, but the company reports over 3,000 installer customers and just closed a €13M Series A round.

market.reason: Software for solar and heat pump installers taps into the fast-growing renewables industry across Europe, but it is still a niche tool for one type of trade business.

tech.reason: Combining CRM, solar design, and AI chat tools into one platform is solid engineering, but a well-funded competitor could build a similar suite within a year or two.

entry.twist: The platform includes AI agents that draft offers, follow up with leads, and answer technical questions about parts and error codes, so a small installer can run more like a big company.
entry.who_pays: Small and medium-sized companies that install solar panels, heat pumps, and other renewable equipment, who pay for the software subscription.
entry.why_now: Governments and homeowners across Europe are installing solar panels and heat pumps faster than ever, and the small installer companies doing the work are overwhelmed with paperwork and manual admin.
